### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **51** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **12** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**11** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/hook-bodies.mdx`  _(via ScriptContext (symbol, a top-level interface), body.source (literal, a string literal in refuseUndeclaredLiteralTextKey; a string literal in undeclaredHookTextKeyAtSave))_
- `content/docs/automation/hooks.mdx`  _(via crm_task (literal, a string literal in a comment in HookSchema), follow_up_subject (literal, a string literal in a comment in HookSchema; a string literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/kernel/architecture.mdx`  _(via getService (symbol, a field of interface HookTextOptions; a field of interface InProcessHookOptions))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via getService (symbol, a field of interface HookTextOptions; a field of interface InProcessHookOptions))_
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/audit-service.mdx`  _(via getService (symbol, a field of interface HookTextOptions; a field of interface InProcessHookOptions))_
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/settings-service.mdx`  _(via SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY (literal, a string literal in isUnregisteredSetting), SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE (literal, a string literal in isUnregisteredSetting))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via getService (symbol, a field of interface HookTextOptions; a field of interface InProcessHookOptions))_

- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via getService (symbol, a field of interface HookTextOptions; a field of interface InProcessHookOptions))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via HookSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via crm_task (literal, a string literal in a comment in HookSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via HookSchema (symbol, a top-level const), bindAppArtifactHandlers (symbol, a top-level function), SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY (literal, a string literal in isUnregisteredSetting))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **12** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **185** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b4be2bf1fe57667d52b373ba68b108db576b5261` — the merge of head `7b8d110d6c524f77f7a808dd227b8b10039644da` into base `60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b4be2bf1fe57667d52b373ba68b108db576b5261 && git checkout b4be2bf1fe57667d52b373ba68b108db576b5261
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be 7b8d110d6c524f77f7a808dd227b8b10039644da && git checkout -B drift-repro 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be && git merge --no-ff 7b8d110d6c524f77f7a808dd227b8b10039644da

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 60552cd9398ad516ed367cd41530188fe97542be` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

### REWORK

1. **A hook text's `{{ }}` hole holding logic, an unknown formatter or nothing is promised refused, and nothing refuses it.**
   - `HookTextSchema.params` (`hook.zod.ts`), and the generated `references/data/hook.mdx:98`, say: "A hole over any other name, logic, an unknown formatter and an empty hole are refused."
   - The schema runs only `closedScopeTemplateRefusal`. By its own docblock (`flow-text-slot-template.ts`), that judges a hole's root and leaves "a hole that does not compile as a path (logic, an unknown formatter)" to `validateExpression('template', …)`.
   - For a refusal entry, that compile half is `validate-hook-refusal-templates.ts` (#33214), which runs on `objectstack validate`, on `compile` and at the publish gate. This PR does not extend it to `texts`, and `hook-texts.test.ts` pins no such case.
   - So `texts.x = { message: 'Follow up: {{ lead | shout }}', params: ['lead'] }` saves and validates. At run time `fillHookTemplateParams` cannot render it and returns the template, braces and all, into the business record.
   - The same happens for a translated template: `hook-text.ts` hands the picked translation to the filler, and on a render failure the record gets the raw translation. Meanwhile the warning reads "so it is written as declared", which it is not.
   - Fix (root):
     - Extend the compile half to `texts.*.message` for an entry with `params`: logic, unknown formatter, empty hole, and the currency-without-code rule if it applies to a hook text.
     - Pin each case with a CONTROL.
     - Make the run-time fallback and its warning agree. Either a translation that does not render falls back to the declared `message` rendered, or the warning says what is written.
     - If extending the lint pass is outside the amended surface, say so on the card first. The alternative is to narrow the two sentences to what is refused and file the compile half as a card; L1 prefers the root fix.
2. **Body, no head move: a closing-keyword hit.** Line 10 reads "…and carries `Fixes #34374`" about PR2. A literal `Fixes #N` in the body, inline code included, is a hit on the whole-body scan, and this PR must not close #34374 (`Part of #34374` is right). Reword it, for example "PR2 carries the closing keyword for #34374".

- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added` match amended declaration 6934421739: a new optional `texts`, a new translation key, and a new `@objectstack/core` export. Nothing that was accepted before is refused. `Skills-docs: follow-up #34546` points at an open card that names `texts` and `ctx.text`. The changeset carries the same three lines and grades:

  - All five are published. `metadata-protocol` is touched by one forced test only.
- **File surface:** 46 files from `get_files`, inside claim 6931101802, surface amendment 6931157938 and split 6931459308, with one exception. Amendment 6931157938 says "`skills/**` stays out of this PR", and the PR moves two `skills/*/references/_index.md` lines (the generator adds `HookTextSchema` to the export list). The body names them as a `gen:skill-refs` regeneration. They still need a `File surface amended` note on the card, because they decide the governed reading (see Owed).
- **Mechanism, read in the source:**
  - `buildHookTextSurface` refuses an undeclared key with a `SandboxError` built from `undeclaredHookTextAtRun`.
  - It reads the language through `readOrganizationTextLocale(getService, session.organizationId)`.
  - It translates `hooks.<hook>.texts.<key>.message` through the negotiated `i18n` service and falls back to the declared `message` on a miss or a throw.

  - `readOrganizationTextLocale` reads a set value (`source !== 'default'`), else the app default. It treats `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_*` as "not set" and rethrows any other failure. `service-automation` drops its private copy for this function.
  - The save-time checks refuse `texts` on an `expression` body or on a hook with no code, at `texts`. They refuse an undeclared literal `ctx.text('…')` key at `body.source` / `handler`.
- **Tests and controls:**
  - The integration pin (real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` + QuickJS) runs both paths and asserts on the stored task row.
  - It covers: the zh-CN translation for an en-US caller; a set ja-JP winning in the write's organization, with a CONTROL that the `default` placeholder does not; the declared sentence with no translation; `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY` → app default while `SETTINGS_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` rejects with no task written; and an undeclared key rejecting with the hook and the key named.

### ① Derived judgments

- `HookSchema.texts` (new optional key, record of snake_case key to `HookTextSchema`): right, and a widening. `HookSchema` is a `strictObject`, so `texts` was an unknown key and refused on `main`; no alias on `main` mapped it elsewhere.
